text: mun ya kirani ya ce ma tura mai kudi.
reply:
🟠 *Ku yi hankali: akwai alamun gargaɗi*

Wannan zai iya zama yaudara. Kada ku biya komai.

1. Tabbatar da ko mutumin da kuke magana da shi na gaske ne ta hanyar kiran su a lambar da kuka sani.
2. Kar a mika kudi ga wanda ba ku san shi sosai ba, musamman idan ya nemi ku biya kafin ku karɓi kuɗin.
3. Duba ko akwai wasu alamu na yaudara da suka dace da abubuwan da aka ambata a sama.

*Inda za ku kai rahoto:*
• Bankinku: Ku kira lambar da ke bayan katin bankinku ko wadda ke shafin yanar gizon bankin na hukuma
• EFCC (kai rahoton laifukan kuɗi): https://www.efcc.gov.ng
• Manhajar EFCC Eagle Eye (rahoto ba tare da suna ba): Eagle Eye (Play Store / App Store)
• Cibiyar yaƙi da laifukan intanet ta 'yan sanda (NPF-NCCC): https://nccc.npf.gov.ng/ereport

_Jagora ce kawai, ba shawarar kuɗi ta ƙwararru ba._

label: scam
text: wọ́n ní BVN mi ti díná kí n fi ránṣẹ́ sí wọn.
reply:
🔴 *Èyí jọ Ẹ̀TÀN*

Èyí lè jẹ́ àwùjọ. Banki rẹ kò ní béèrè fún BVN, PIN, ọ̀rọ̀ ìkọ̀kọ̀ tàbí àlàyé kaadi nípasẹ̀ pè, SMS, WhatsApp, tàbí média sósì.

1. Má ṣe pín kóòdù náà. Pari ìjíròrò náà lẹ́sẹkẹsẹ.
2. Tí o bá ti pín rẹ̀, kan si banki rẹ nípasẹ̀ nọ́mbà wọn tó yẹ lẹ́sẹkẹsẹ láti jabo ìṣẹlẹ náà.
3. Yipada PIN àti ọrọìwòye fún gbogbo àkọọlẹ.

*Ibi tí ẹ ti lè fi ẹjọ́ sùn:*
• Báǹkì yín: Ẹ pe nọ́mbà tó wà lẹ́yìn káàdì báǹkì yín tàbí èyí tó wà lórí ojú-ìwé ayélujára báǹkì náà
• EFCC (ẹ fi ẹ̀sùn ìwà ọ̀daràn owó sùn): https://www.efcc.gov.ng
• Ìṣàfilọ́lẹ̀ EFCC Eagle Eye (ìfisùn láìdárúkọ): Eagle Eye (Play Store / App Store)
• Ẹ̀ka ọlọ́pàá fún ìwà ọ̀daràn orí íntánẹ́ẹ̀tì (NPF-NCCC): https://nccc.npf.gov.ng/ereport

_Ìtọ́sọ́nà nìkan ni, kì í ṣe ìmọ̀ràn ìṣúná owó._
body:
Èyí lè jẹ́ àwùjọ. Banki rẹ kò ní béèrè fún BVN, PIN, ọ̀rọ̀ ìkọ̀kọ̀ tàbí àlàyé kaadi nípasẹ̀ pè, SMS, WhatsApp, tàbí média sósì.

1. Má ṣe pín kóòdù náà. Pari ìjíròrò náà lẹ́sẹkẹsẹ.
2. Tí o bá ti pín rẹ̀, kan si banki rẹ nípasẹ̀ nọ́mbà wọn tó yẹ lẹ́sẹkẹsẹ láti jabo ìṣẹlẹ náà.
3. Yipada PIN àti ọrọìwòye fún gbogbo àkọọlẹ.
english: They said my BVN has been blocked and I need to send them money.
reply_english:
This is likely a scam. Your bank will never ask for your BVN, PIN, password, or card details by call, SMS, WhatsApp, or social media.

1. Do not share the code. End the call or chat immediately.
2. If you already shared it, contact your bank using their official number right away to report the incident.
3. Change your PIN and password for all accounts.

reply:

Èyí jẹ́ ẹ̀tàn. Ilé-ifowopamọ rẹ kò ní béèrè fún BVN rẹ tàbí kó fi ìhalẹ̀mọ́ni pé wọ́n máa dènà.
1. Má ṣe pín kóòdù náà. Parí ìjíròrò náà lẹsẹkẹsẹ.
2. Tí o bá ti pín tẹlẹ, kan si ilé-ifowopamọ rẹ nípasẹ̀ nǹkan osise wọn lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ.
3. Yipada gbogbo PIN àti ọrọìwòye rẹ.

*Ibi tí ẹ ti lè fi ẹjọ́ sùn:*
• Báǹkì yín: Ẹ pe nọ́mbà tó wà lẹ́yìn káàdì báǹkì yín tàbí èyí tó wà lórí ojú-ìwé ayélujára báǹkì náà

1. Má ṣe pín kóòdù náà. Parí ìjíròrò náà lẹsẹkẹsẹ.
2. Tí o bá ti pín tẹlẹ, kan si ilé-ifowopamọ rẹ nípasẹ̀ nǹkan osise wọn lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ.

english: Dear friend, they are asking me to provide my BVN number, and they said that my BVN is blocked so I cannot send it to them.
reply_english:
This is a scam. Your bank will never ask for your BVN or threaten to block it.
1. Do not share any code. End the call immediately.
2. If you already shared it, contact your bank using their official number right away.
3. Change all your PINs and passwords.
